【AI Training SOS / 煉丹求助】

這是一個基於 GAN 的人像生成訓練記錄。目前遇到了嚴重的瓶頸，希望能有技術大佬指點方向。

I am training a GAN model focused on human body generation (mainly flesh tones). Currently stuck at a bottleneck where the model only produces blurry "flesh blocks" without fine details.

【AI Training SOS / 煉丹求助：幫忙評估哪組權重生成的圖片比較好】

這是一個基於 GAN 的人像生成訓練記錄。目前訓練出了一些不同階段的結果，但我有點當局者迷，希望能有大佬幫忙看看哪一組圖片（權重狀態）看起來最有潛力！

I am training a GAN model focused on human body generation (mainly flesh tones). I have saved weights at different epochs, but I need some experienced eyes to tell me which images/weights look the most promising and have the best shapes.

Current Status (目前進度與操作):

Epoch 0-40: Basic color convergence (從雜訊收斂到初步色塊).

Epoch 40-150: Decreased LR to 0.00005 + Doubled Dataset. Resulted in "Mode Collapse" (模型陷入局部擬合，構圖高度重複，但主體與背景有分離).

Recent: Increased LR back to 0.0001. Edges became sharper, and some internal shadows appeared, but with grid artifacts. (邊緣變銳利，開始出現陰影，但有網格感).

My Main Questions (主要想請大家幫忙看的重點):

Visual Evaluation (視覺評估): Which epoch's images look the best or have the most correct "structure" to you? (各位覺得上傳的這幾張圖中，哪個階段的權重產生的形狀比較好看、最有希望發展出細節？)

Direction Check (方向確認): Does the current "flesh block" shape mean it's learning correctly, or is it going the wrong way? (目前的肉塊形狀發展是對的嗎？哪一組的輪廓看起來最自然？)

Checkpoint Choice (權重選擇): I have saved weights for all stages. Which checkpoint should I resume my training from? (我保留了所有階段的權重，大家建議我應該基於哪一組「看起來最好」的權重繼續往下訓練？)

任何關於「哪張圖看起來更有潛力」的建議，或是後續該從哪個權重繼續訓練的指點，對我來說都非常寶貴，感謝各位幫忙看圖！
Any advice on which epoch looks the best visually, or which checkpoint I should use to continue training, would be greatly appreciated!
Current Status (目前進度):

Epoch 0-40: Basic color convergence (從雜訊收斂到色塊).

Epoch 40-150: Decreased LR to 0.00005 + Doubled Dataset. Resulted in "Mode Collapse" (模型陷入局部擬合，構圖高度重複).

Recent: Increased LR back to 0.0001. Edges became sharper, but "Checkerboard Artifacts" (棋盤效應/網格感) are very severe.

Technical Questions (想請教的問題):

Checkerboard Artifacts: How to fix the grid patterns? Should I replace ConvTranspose2d with Upsample + Conv2d?

Detail Improvement: How to push the model to generate facial features or limbs instead of just "pink blobs"?

Weights: I have saved weights for all stages. If you are willing to help analyze the .pth files, please let me know in the comments!

任何建議（調整學習率、修改網路層、數據集清洗）對我來說都非常寶貴，感謝各位！
Any advice on LR scheduling, architecture changes, or dataset filtering would be greatly appreciated!
